grammarFocus: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门。
title: A Healthy Week at the Community Centre
instructions: 这是为A2水平学习者设计的听力练习。请先听录音（或阅读transcript），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。所有答案必须来自录音内容。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look tired today. Are you okay?
Ben: Hi, Mia. Yes, I'm fine, but I'm a little tired. I went to bed late last night because I watched a football match.
Mia: Oh, I see. You should go to bed earlier. Sleep is very important for health.
Ben: You're right. I usually sleep about six hours, but I know I should sleep more. How about you?
Mia: I sleep about eight hours every night. I feel good because I go to bed at ten and get up at six.
Ben: That's a good habit. Do you do exercise?
Mia: Yes, I do. I go swimming twice a week. It's my favourite sport. I think swimming is the best exercise for me because it's fun and good for my back.
Ben: I don't like swimming. I prefer running. I run in the park every morning before work.
Mia: That's great. Running is faster than walking, so it's good for your heart. But you should be careful. Don't run too fast.
Ben: I know. I run slowly. But sometimes I feel very tired after running.
Mia: Maybe you should eat a good breakfast. A healthy breakfast gives you energy.
Ben: I usually eat a banana and some bread. Is that okay?
Mia: Yes, that's fine. But you should also drink water. Water is better than coffee for health.
Ben: I drink a lot of coffee because I work in an office. I feel sleepy in the afternoon.
Mia: Coffee is okay, but water is the best drink. You should drink more water and less coffee.
Ben: Okay, I will try. Thanks for your advice, Mia.
Mia: You're welcome. Remember, good habits are the most important thing for health.

options: He went to bed late because he watched a football match.
He did a lot of exercise.
He woke up early to run.

grammar.title: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because 表示原因，so 表示结果。should 用来提建议，意思是“应该”。比较级用于两者比较，最高级用于三者或以上比较。例如：better 是 good 的比较级，best 是最高级。
grammar.example: I went to bed late last night because I watched a football match.

questions.prompt: I feel tired ______ I went to bed late.
questions.evidence: I went to bed late last night because I watched a football match.

questions.prompt: You ______ drink more water. It is good for you.
questions.evidence: You should drink more water and less coffee.

questions.explanation: 两者比较用比较级，fast的比较级是faster。

questions.prompt: Water is the ______ drink for health.
questions.explanation: 三者或以上比较用最高级，good的最高级是best。
